title: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
description: An intellectual introduction to computer science and programming. Learn how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with interactive Cloud IDE problem sets.

modules.title: Week 1: C Syntax, Data Types & Conditionals
Week 3: Algorithmic Efficiency, Big O & Sorting
Week 5: Data Structures, Linked Lists & Tries
Week 6: Python Syntax, OOP & File I/O
Week 8: HTML, CSS & JavaScript Web Development
Week 9: Flask Web Applications & MVC Architecture

title: CS50P: Introduction to Programming with Python
description: An introduction to programming using Python for students with or without prior programming experience. Covers functions, variables, conditionals, loops, exceptions, libraries, unit tests with pytest, file I/O, regex, and OOP.

modules.title: Week 6: File I/O, CSV & Image Processing

title: Responsive Web Design Certification
description: Learn HTML for structure and CSS for styling. Build responsive websites that look beautiful on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens with modern Flexbox, CSS Grid, and accessibility practices, ending with 5 certification projects.

modules.title: Module 5: CSS Box Model & Margins (Rothko Painting)

title: JavaScript Algorithms and Data Structures
description: Learn modern JavaScript (ES6+), object-oriented programming, and functional programming. Build interactive browser games, algorithms, and 5 certification projects including a Cash Register and Pokémon Search App.

modules.title: Module 3: DOM Manipulation & Role Playing Game
Module 5: ES6 Classes, Scope & Calorie Counter

title: Intro to JS: Drawing & Animation
description: Learn how to program drawings, animations, and games in JavaScript using the ProcessingJS library. Highly interactive with live code editors, visual output, and guided creative challenges.

modules.title: Unit 4: Logic, If Statements & Bouncing Ball

title: Introduction to Computer Science and Programming in Python
description: MIT's flagship introduction to computational problem solving. Focuses on Python, branching, iteration, functions, tuples, lists, object-oriented programming, algorithmic complexity, and numerical computation with complete lecture streams and problem sets.

modules.title: Lecture 9: Algorithmic Complexity & Big O Notation

title: Linear Algebra (Gilbert Strang)
description: Professor Gilbert Strang's renowned MIT course on linear algebra. Covers matrix factorizations, vector spaces, orthogonality, determinants, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and singular value decomposition (SVD). Essential math for machine learning.

modules.title: Lecture 1: Geometry of Linear Equations & Matrices
Lecture 2: Elimination with Matrices & Matrix Operations

title: Machine Learning Specialization
description: Created by AI pioneer Andrew Ng. Master foundational machine learning concepts and how to apply these techniques to build real-world AI applications using Python and NumPy (100% free access via Coursera's audit mode).

modules.title: Course 1: Supervised Machine Learning: Regression and Classification
Course 2: Advanced Learning Algorithms & Neural Networks
Course 2: Decision Trees and Tree Ensembles
Course 3: Unsupervised Learning, Recommenders, Reinforcement Learning

title: Machine Learning Crash Course
description: Google's fast-paced, practical introduction to machine learning featuring a series of video lectures, interactive visualizations, and hands-on coding exercises using Python and TensorFlow in Google Colab.

modules.title: Module 1: Introduction to ML, Framing & Datasets
Module 6: Neural Networks Architecture & Activation Functions

title: Foundations Course
description: The open-source community curriculum that takes you from complete beginner to capable developer. Learn command line ergonomics, Git/GitHub version control, HTML structure, modern CSS Flexbox, and JavaScript basics through hands-on project creation.

modules.title: Module 1: How this Course Works & Installation Setup
Module 2: Command Line Basics & Terminal Navigation
Module 5: CSS Foundations & The Box Model
Module 6: Modern Flexbox & Project: Landing Page

title: Full Stack Open 2024
description: University of Helsinki's premier full-stack course. Deep dive into React, Redux, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, TypeScript, GraphQL, Docker containerization, and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines with free ECTS university credits.

modules.title: Part 2: Communicating with Server & REST APIs
Part 3: Programming a Server with NodeJS and Express
Part 4: Testing Express Servers & User Administration
Part 5: Testing React Apps & Token Authentication
Part 7: React Router, Custom Hooks & Styling
Part 8: GraphQL Client and Apollo Server

title: Elements of AI: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
description: A series of free online courses created by MinnaLearn and the University of Helsinki. Learn what AI is, what can (and can't) be done with AI, and how AI methods are developed. Combines theory with practical visual exercises.

modules.title: Chapter 4: Machine Learning (Linear Regression & Nearest Neighbor)
Chapter 6: Implications of AI (Societal Impact & Ethics)
